sense: a clip on a phone or computer

terms.comment: Our choice: no reference work has a word for a video. A film is Traupman’s pellicula cinēmatographica (see film), which Andresian (p. 15) shortens to pellicula; a video is the same thing, short, on a phone. Classically pellicula is a small skin or hide (Lewis & Short), the source of the modern “film”.
Morgan–Owens offers it with a question mark.

sources: Lewis & Short: pellicula · Lewis & Short: segmentum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 52.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. video clip.
